SHOP_BOUGHT: Your new vehicle ({0}) is waiting outside
SHOP_ERR_GONE: That vehicle is not sold here
SHOP_ERR_DENIED: This shop does not sell to you
SHOP_ERR_MONEY: You do not have enough money
UI_PICK_HINT: Choose one below to look it over and paint it.
ADMIN_TAB_CATALOG_DESC: Every vehicle players can buy, its price and category.
ADMIN_C_VEHICLE_DESC: Which model it is and what it costs.
ADMIN_H_MODEL: The GTA spawn name (sultan, adder, bati).
ADMIN_H_LABEL: Empty uses the game's own name.
ADMIN_H_CATEGORY: Shops sell the categories they list (sedans, sports, motorcycles...).
ADMIN_TAB_SHOPS_DESC: Where players buy vehicles and which categories each shop sells.
ADMIN_C_SHOP_DESC: Where players open the shop and what it sells.
ADMIN_H_COORDS: Stand where players open the shop and use your position.
ADMIN_H_JOBS: Empty: everyone may buy. Otherwise only these jobs (a police fleet dealer).
ADMIN_C_SHOWROOM_DESC: Where the previewed vehicle stands, where the camera looks from and where bought vehicles come out.
ADMIN_H_PREVIEW: Stand where the shown vehicle should be, facing its front direction.
ADMIN_H_CAMERA: Look at the preview spot with the game camera and use the camera position.
ADMIN_H_DELIVERY: Where bought vehicles appear, facing your direction.
